posts.t:
Wild defeat the Kraken 5-1. 

Kaprizov scores early
Maatta with his first in a Wild sweater
Coleman x2
JEEK
Kraken’s Jared McCann to miss game against Wild with injury

The #SeaKraken  have recalled forward Jani Nyman from the Coachella Valley Firebirds.

Additionally, forward Jared McCann is being evaluated for a lower-body injury and will not be available for tonight’s game.

#SeaKraken win 5-3 over UTA

🥅 Grubauer - so so good. Again.
🏒 Samo - his second GWG this season (and 2nd in 2 GP)
⚡️ Two PPGs for each team
🏒 Kraken bend but don't break- play UTA as even as they ever have - won 67% of puck battles
🏒 Two point nights for Eberle and Montour
This is gorgeous work from the FOW to the movement from Catton and Kakko and Beniers' finish #SeaKraken

#SeaKraken win 4-3 in a shootout over DET

🥅 Solid first 40 and change, then weathered the storm in P3 as Wings pushed
🥅 Tweak to top 6 pays off with a Samo goal
🏒 McMann with his second SO winner of the season
🏒 Always love a Gaudreau SO goal
Lane Lambert says Montour is a game time decision for #SeaKraken

#SeaKraken  fall 8-3 to FLA

🏒 Road trip ends with 3-1-1 record - seven important standings points
🏒 Gaudreau scores again-4-2-6 on the trip
🏒 Wright pots one and Kakko gets his 50th assist with SEA
🥊 Not enough puck battles won in this one
🥅 Regroup, re-focus and get ready for a home stand
Per #SeaKraken defenseman Brandon Montour will not play tonight due to a lower-body injury. He is listed as day-to-day.

#SeaKraken  fall 4-3 in OT to TBL

🥅 Earn a valuable point against a tough opponent
🥅 Grubauer had same top tier saves (again!)
🏒 Beniers gets to 200 points on the tying goal to force OT
🏒 Both sides of special teams come up big
🏒 Gaudreau line scores (again!)
🏥 Montour leaves the game in P2 (LB)
#SeaKraken tie it 3-3 and congratulations, Matty Beniers YOU have 200 NHL points!
Per #SeaKraken PR, Brandon Montour (lower body) will not return to tonight's game
